# This file is generated by AI.

find_package(Catch2 3 CONFIG REQUIRED)

add_executable(webgal-render-tests
    bridge_test.cpp
    live2d_test.cpp
    shaders_test.cpp
)

target_link_libraries(webgal-render-tests
    PRIVATE
        webgal-video-render
        Catch2::Catch2WithMain
)

# 测试会直接包含内部头 (live2d/core_loader.hpp, shaders/embedded_shaders.hpp).
target_include_directories(webgal-render-tests PRIVATE ${WEBGAL_RENDER_INTERNAL_INCLUDES})

include(Catch)
catch_discover_tests(webgal-render-tests)

if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(webgal-render-tests PRIVATE /utf-8)
endif()
